answer.methodology: Ranked all supplied candidates by ESM-2 masked-marginal ΔlnP plus ESM-IF1 backbone-conditioned ΔlnP; larger is better. BLOSUM62 was used as independent validation and not added to the ranking score. BLAST-MSA retrieval and DSSP parsing failed, so no homolog/PSSM or DSSP claims are made. No assay outcome is claimed.
